_comment: Model manifest. Every URL and sizeBytes here was verified against the Hugging Face Hub,
3.0 ships three files and no choices: Silero for voice detection, Parakeet for speech
recognition, and Gemma 3 1B for transcript correction. There is no RAM tier, no per-role
pick and no charging-only model. A phone either has enough memory to run this set or it
Digests: the VAD and ASR entries carry SHA-256 values computed by downloading those exact
URLs and hashing the bytes. The GGUF does not, because its digest is not retrievable
without downloading it; its sizeBytes is exact, which is what catches the realistic
failure of a truncated or interrupted download, and hashVerified:false says so.

models.notes: Gates ASR so speech recognition only runs on actual speech. Tiny, and the single biggest battery saving in the pipeline. Without it the app falls back to an energy threshold.
English transcription. Archive contains encoder.int8.onnx, decoder.int8.onnx, joiner.int8.onnx and tokens.txt; the installer flattens them into models/asr/ and discards the bundled test audio.

The only language model in 3.0, and the only thing it is asked to do is correct transcript lines. Chosen because it has no reasoning mode and so cannot emit think tokens, which is what made the previous model spend minutes and a thousand tokens on a one-line correction. Under Google's Gemma terms, not a standard open licence.
